ddl.name: secrets_personal_inference_key_idx
ddl.where: "secrets"."purpose" = 'inference_key' and "secrets"."user_id" is not null and "secrets"."workspace_id" is null

ddl.name: tasks_ci_retry_event_unique
ddl.where: "tasks"."creation_source" = 'webhook' AND "tasks"."ci_retry_pr_number" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."ci_retry_head_sha" IS NOT NULL

ddl.name: tasks_conflict_retry_event_unique
ddl.where: "tasks"."conflict_retry_pr_number" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."conflict_retry_head_sha" IS NOT NULL

ddl.name: tasks_reviewer_retry_event_unique
ddl.where: "tasks"."reviewer_retry_pr_number" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."reviewer_retry_head_sha" IS NOT NULL

ddl.name: tasks_one_pending_review_per_head_unique
ddl.where: "tasks"."category" = 'review' AND "tasks"."status" = 'pending' AND "tasks"."creation_source" = 'webhook' AND "tasks"."parent_task_id" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."subject_pr_number" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."subject_head_sha" IS NOT NULL

ddl.name: experiment_assignments_task_or_message
ddl.value: "experiment_assignments"."task_id" IS NOT NULL OR "experiment_assignments"."message_id" IS NOT NULL
